title: Appendix III – Abilities and keywords
body:
Original appendix from the German tournament rulebook. The source wording is preserved; translated explanations are available in the glossary.

**Übersicht Fähigkeiten und Keywords**

| Name | Regeltext | Anmerkung/Beispiel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Advisor** | This Character can only be placed into an Advisor Slot. |  |
| **Provide Antidote** | Remove all Counters with Degenerating Effect from target Character. | "Degenerating Effect" Counters sind Statuswert reduzierende Marken sowie negative Zustände erzeugende Counter, Zustände die hiervon betroffen sind haben das Key-Word "Degenerating Effect". |
| **Barrier** | This Character can only be placed into a War Zone and only if there is no other Barrier. It doesn't occupy a Slot in that Zone. This Character can't perfom combat actions. As long as this Character is the only Character you control in that War Zone, attacking Characters in the same War Zone gain Targeted Strike with this Character as its attack choice. | Die Barriere befindet sich im Spiel, verbraucht jedoch keinen Slot auf dem Spielfeld. |
| **Blood Mage** | ASP generated by this Permanent count as generated by a Blood Mage. |  |
| **Blood Rush [X]** | This Character gains +X+X POW/HP until the end of this round. At the end of this round, banish this Character. |  |
| **Defender** | This Character does not turn, when using a Block Reaction. |  |
| **Dual Slot** | This Character occupies two Slots in play instead of one. | Wenn keine zwei Slots frei sind, kann eine Karte mit Dual Slot nicht legal auf dem Spielfeld liegen. |
| **Ecstasy** | Target Character gains Two-Handed Combat and Indestructible until the end of this round. It can only use attack actions this combat. Sacrifice this Character at the end of Combat. | Keyword; Es muss mit dem Charakter im Kampf die Aktion Angriff gewählt werden mit allen Aktionen, die dem Charakter zur Verfügung stehen. |
| **Fear** | When this character gets frear, roll a six sided die. If this Characters RES is equal or lower than to the result of this roll, turn it, if it is unturned and it doesn't unturn at the beginning of the next round. |  |
| **Fight** | This Character deals DMG equal to its POW to target Character. That Character deals DMG equal to its POW to this Character. Use the current POW of the fighting Characters as this Ability resolves. |  |
| **First Damage** | This Character deals DMG during the First Damage step of combat, instead of the regular Damage step. |  |
| **Flying** | This Character can only be blocked by Characters with Flying or Skyguard. |  |
| **Force of Nature** | You may place Characters into each of your War Zones as if it had three Slots instead of 2. |  |
| **Fuse** | Choose and sacrifice X permanents named [Name] in Target Lane, then create a permanent token as described by the rule text of the Fuse effect. | Choose 3 Creeper Plant Token in target Lane, then fuse them into a 4/4 Giant Creeper Plant Token. |
| **Hideout** | When you play this card, you may pay 2 ASP to play it face down into a Front Row Slot of your Opponent, instead of a regular summoning. If you do, this card enters play face down. Opponents may place Characters into that Slot as if it weren’t occupied. The face down permanent has“{2}: Turn this Card face up and place it into an empty Slot in your War Zone in the same Lane. If you can’t place it this way, sacrifice it. “ and “If your opponent places a Character into the same Slot as this Permanent, if it is face down, then turn it face up and sacrifice it.” | Hideout kann in eine inaktive Lane des Gegners platziert werden. Die mit Hideout gespielte Karte wird verdeckt auf die Reaktionskette gelegt. Um eine verdeckte Karte aufdecken zu können, benötigt der aufdeckende Spieler Priorität. |
| **Indestructable** | This permanent can't be destroyed. Prevent all DMG that would be dealt to this Character. | Der Zonenwechsel, welcher durch "Zerstören" ausgelöst wird, wird stattdessen nicht durchgeführt. |
| **Infiltrate** | Keyword indicating, that this Card has an effect to permanents in the Safety Zone |  |
| **Lord of the Dead** | Keyword indicating a triggered ability, whenever a Character you control dies. |  |
| **Overrun** | When this Character enters play it deals DMG equal to its POW to target Character your opponent controls in the same Lane | Der DMG Wert ist durch den Trigger beim auslösen festgelegt, nicht beim Verrechnen. |
| **Paralyze** | Keyword indicating a triggered ability: "When this Character uses Ranged Combat, roll a six sided die for each Character in the War Zone of the same Lane. If you roll a 1 to 3, turn that Character, it doesn't unturn at beginning of the next round." | Auch eigene Charaktere sind davon betroffen. |
| **Poison** | Whenever this Character deals DMG to another Character, put a Poison Counter on that Character. |  |
| **Poisoned** | This Character has the Poisoned Condition. |  |
| **Protection from Everything** | This card can't be the target of Spells, Abilities and Trainings your opponent controls. Prevent all DMG that would be dealt to this Card. |  |
| **Protective Shield** | (T): The next time target Character you control in the same War Zone would take DMG, that DMG is dealt to this Character instead. |  |
| **Punch** | As long as this Character is in a War Zone and attacking it has "If this Character deals more combat DMG than the current HP of a Character blocking it, it deals the excess DMG to the Sovereign of the defending Player ." | Kampfschaden wird nur im Kampfschadenschritt zugefügt. Überschuss Schaden kann nur passieren, wenn der DMG größer als die aktuellen HP sind. Der Gesamtschaden wird aufgeteilt zwischen dem Blocker und dem Herrscher. Es gibt hierbei keine Verteilungswahl, sondern nur den fixen Wert aus der HP/DMG Differenz. |
| **Ranged Combat** | As long as this Character is placed in the Back Row, it may attack a Character your opponent controls in the War Zone of the same Lane. If it does, the attacked Character doesn’t get a block Reaction and this Character deals combat DMG equal to its POW to that Character. | Der angegriffene Charakter wird nicht zu einem Block gezwungen, er erhält lediglich den Schaden aus dem Angriff. Ranged Combat ist eine Angriffsmodifikation und zielt daher nicht im regeltechnischen Sinne. |
| **Regenerate [X]** | Remove DMG from a Character equal to X. | Das Entfernen von Schaden, erhöht die aktuellen HP des Charakters. Ist kein Schaden mehr übrig, kann auch nichts regeneriert werden. |
| **Regenerate [X] LP** | Reduce your accumulated LP loss by X. | Regeneration von LP reduziert den akkumulierten LP-Verlust um X. Der akkumulierte LP-Verlust kann dadurch nicht unter 0 sinken. |
| **Rise into** | Search your Spell Deck for a card named [name of the Card to rise into] and place it into this Permanents slot. Transfer all Counters placed on this Permanent onto the risen Permanent. Then sacrifice this permanent. | Rise ist selbst eine Keywordmechanik, die Aktivierung und alternativen Ausspielmodi sind auf den jeweiligen Karten definiert. |
| **Rune** | Keywordability indicating that this card has to be placed into the Rune Slot at the beginning of the game. |  |
| **Second Round; Third Round** | Keywordability that indicates a tracking of the total rounds past after this permanent entered play. |  |
| **Skyguard** | This Character may block Characters with Flying, as if they doesn't have Flying. |  |

Trained Characters, Artifacts and Rituals count as Magical Items. | Ausschließlich Spells können den Charakter legal als Ziel anvisieren. |

Name Regeltext Anmerkung/Beispiel

As long as this Character is the only Character you control in that War Zone, attacking Characters in the same War Zone gain Targeted Strike with this Character as its attack choice. Die Barriere befindet sich im Spiel, verbraucht jedoch keinen Slot auf dem Spielfeld.
